| Coachella | |-| | [![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/28/Coachella18W1-18_%2842058161311%29.jpg/250px-Coachella18W1-18_%2842058161311%29.jpg)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Coachella18W1-18_(42058161311).jpg)
Coachella in 2018 | | Dates | Two consecutive 3-day weekends in April (currently) | | Yearsactive | 1999, 2001–2019, 2022–present | | ![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/f/fb/Current_event_clock.svg/20px-Current_event_clock.svg.png)_[Coachella 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coachella_2026)_ | ## History ### 2018–2019 Coachella celebrated its 20th anniversary in [2019](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coachella_2019). ### 2020–present The 2020 festival was originally scheduled to take place on April 10–12 and April 17–19 with [Rage Against the Machine](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rage_Against_the_Machine), [Travis Scott](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Travis_Scott), and [Frank Ocean](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frank_Ocean) as the headlining acts.[[118]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coachella#cite_note-118)[[119]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coachella#cite_note-119) [Due to the COVID-19 pandemic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Impact_of_the_COVID-19_pandemic_on_the_music_industry), the festival was initially postponed until October 9–11 and October 16–18,[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coachella#cite_note-postponement-3) but in June, Riverside County public health officers announced Coachella and Stagecoach had been cancelled altogether due to a ban on public gatherings, as well as [lockdowns](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/COVID-19_lockdowns) and [travel restrictions](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Travel_during_the_COVID-19_pandemic). Coachella returned in [2022](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coachella_2022) on April 15–17 and April 22–24. The [2023 edition](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coachella_2023) of Coachella, which took place from April 14–16 and April 21–23, was also beset with last-minute lineup changes. [[143]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coachella#cite_note-143) On April 12, 2025, [Los Angeles Philharmonic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Los_Angeles_Philharmonic), conducted by [Gustavo Dudamel](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gustavo_Dudamel), became the first major orchestra to perform at Coachella. [Coachella 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coachella_2026) took place between April 10–19. ## Festival summary by year | Edition | Year | Dates | Headliners | Gross

web.title: Coachella Guide for 2027
web.description:
# The Beginner’s Guide to Coachella: What to Pack, Where to Stay, How to Set Up Camp, and More
The 2026 [Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival](https://www.coachella.com/) lineup is officially out: Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, Karol G, The Strokes, and dozens of supporting acts will all gather in April of 2026 along with hundreds of thousands of fans for two weekends of music, sun, food, and desert fun.

#### Where and When Is Coachella?
This year, the 2026 festival will take place over two consecutive spring weekends:

- Weekend 1: Friday, April 10–Sunday, April 12, 2026
- Weekend 2: Friday, April 17–Sunday, April 19, 2026
